summary: Still unaddressed on main: dxcompiler's and dxildll's CMake targets remain hardcoded SHARED (unchanged since 2016 and since dxildll entered this repo in 2024, respectively), and no PR or maintainer reply in this thread has accepted or declined the contributor's proposed STATIC option. Related issue #5985 cites this one directly and ties static linking to an unfinished DllMain/LoadLibraryA refactor that a maintainer asked about as recently as 2024-10-28 with no reply since.
